scope: All 161 scenic companion portrait masters and delivered images
forbidden: Single inward spiral village insignia, including pointed spiral-leaf, spiral-centered flame and carved-stone variations on banners, lanterns, headplates and scenery.
retained: Unrelated three-comma, flower, bird, throwing-star and geometric crests; natural creature markings and elemental effects.
method: Manual visual inspection of every delivered portrait, full-size review of every edited output, and magnified review of ambiguous background details. Hash checks bind the review to files; they do not detect symbols.
provider: 51 corrections through built-in image_gen; Brook Newt direct pixel repair explicitly authorized by the user after three service rejections.

entries.review: Full native output visually inspected: All foreground and distant banners plain; stone shell, turtle face, red scarf, sword and anatomy preserved.

entries.review: Full native output visually inspected: Left banner and lantern are plain; lizard face, natural spots, four limbs, blue clothes and tail preserved.

Exactly 11123 pixels changed within the banner mask; all RGB pixels outside it, including the entire Brook Newt character, remain identical.
